history.summary: A 484 sqft 99-year leasehold 1BR in D03 Queenstown at $2165 PSF / $1.048M, essentially on top of EW19 Queenstown MRT (90m). The URA series is robust (202 txns) and the asking is ~3.4% BELOW the $2241 project median — a rare genuine discount on a well-located RCR asset.
history.rating_rationale: Doorstep to Queenstown MRT (90m) in RCR D03, which benefits from the Greater Southern Waterfront and TEL corridor. The 202-txn URA series gives high confidence; asking $2165 PSF is ~3.4% under the $2241 median (a real discount, not marketing). The ~2.85% CAGR is modest, but it's reliably measured and reflects a large mature project. Shoebox format and 99-yr tenure cap upside, but location + discount + sub-$1.05M quantum in a sought-after RCR district make this a sound entry-level Buy.

history.summary: Mildly under-priced 1BR directly connected to Queenstown MRT (best-in-class connectivity), in D03/RCR, with Greater Southern Waterfront upside. Robust transaction data and a decisive physical catalyst (at-door MRT) support a forward edge.
history.rating_rationale: Asking 2,165.29 PSF vs verified 12-month range 2,019-2,405 (avg ~2,231) — the ask sits modestly below the trailing average, consistent with the -9.7% age-adj and -2.5% vs-cohort signals on solid data (202 appreciation txns, 19-txn cohort). The standout is the physical catalyst: Queenstown MRT (EW line, ~15 min to Raffles Place) is directly opposite, with unblocked views and longer-run Greater Southern Waterfront redevelopment upside. D03/RCR is the second-strongest realized forward region. Confidence medium rather than high because the discount is modest (~3%) and high absolute PSF (2,165) limits the value margin for a 484 sqft unit.
red_flags: High absolute PSF (2,165) on a small 484 sqft unit — limited value cushion if the RCR market softens
Discount to comps is modest (~3%), so the edge leans on the MRT/GSW catalyst rather than price

history.summary: Buy (medium) — best value+income case: at-door Queenstown MRT, RCR, slightly cheap-for-age, top yield (4.2%). Shoebox-exit risk.
history.rating_rationale: The cleanest value+income case in the batch. Directly AT Queenstown MRT (~90m) — a decisive, durable rental/exit catalyst — in RCR (2nd-best realized forward region), genuinely slightly cheap for its age (-2.4% vs age-adjusted district median, -6.3% vs new-launch-implied) and with the best yield here (4.2% gross / 2.88% net). Deep liquidity (202 txns, 736 units) and Greater Southern Waterfront long-run optionality. Main risks: a 441 sqft shoebox at a high $2,268 psf has a thin value cushion if RCR softens, and the exit/tenant pool is narrow (investors & singles, not families). Trailing CAGR 2.85% de-weighted. Confidence medium because of the format/cushion — but on a value+yield+location basis this is the highest-conviction pick of the four.
